notes: MAINT-DIST stories defined per required breakdown (schema, logic, API, tests, integration).

change_log.note: Integrate with provider and clinical trial flows

MAINT-DIST-S1.title: Define Distance Calculation Schema and Contract
MAINT-DIST-S1.description: Define input (origin/destination coordinates) and output (distance, duration if available, units) schema for distance computation aligned with existing Google Routes usage.

MAINT-DIST-S2.title: Implement Core Distance Calculation Logic
MAINT-DIST-S2.description: Implement reusable backend service to compute distance between two coordinate pairs using Google Routes API or equivalent logic already present in clinical trials service.

MAINT-DIST-S3.title: Expose Distance Calculation via Service Interface
MAINT-DIST-S3.description: Expose distance calculation through a shared domain service or facade so it can be reused by provider search and clinical trials workflows.

MAINT-DIST-S4.title: Distance Calculation Unit and Edge Case Tests
MAINT-DIST-S4.description: Create unit tests validating correct distance computation, handling of invalid/missing coordinates, and consistency with Google Routes responses.

MAINT-DIST-S5.title: Integrate Distance Logic into Clinical Trials and Provider Flows
MAINT-DIST-S5.description: Refactor existing clinical trials distance usage to call the shared distance service and enable reuse for provider search ranking or display.
